name: [⚡UPD] Phonk Slap 🎵
desc:
🎵 Welcome to Phonk Slap 🎵

Slap players off the map and trigger hype edits!

🎬 Slap & Edit: Every slap triggers a phonk edit!

💜 Aura: Slap players, earn Aura, and unlock rare gloves & cosmetics.

🌀 Abilities: Each glove has a unique game-changing power.

🚫 Cheating leads to a permanent ban.

🎮 Controls: Click or R2 to slap, E or R1 for ability.

🎁 Check our the discord for the latest codes!

Inspired by Slap Battles
